The rule applies not only to state agencies but also to contractors acting on an agency's behalf. The two categories require separate language because section 8 grants the auditor direct authority over agencies and contractual authority over vendors.

An organization must notify affected residents within 30 days after confirming unauthorized disclosure. It may delay notice when a court finds that disclosure would impede an active investigation. The order must identify the investigation and set an expiration date.

Nothing in this section creates a private right of action. Existing remedies under the consumer protection statute remain available.
